content: The Achaea GMCP PDF is old but still useful for exact module semantics: Core.Supports.Set/Add negotiates supported modules, Char.Vitals and Char.Status values are string-encoded and change messages can be partial, Char.Skills.Get returns groups/lists/info depending on supplied group/name, and Char.Items emits List/Add/Remove/Update for room and inventory state. Cross-checking with the current Nexus GMCP page supports using Nexus as the current source and the PDF as historical detail, not as the only authority.
